verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the core flow directly: tap the add button and scan the service's QR code. The changelog adds a scan frame and torch control to the QR scanner, plus desktop import of 2FA codes from QR code images, and the app's TOTP code display is documented. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the QR-scan-to-code flow, and explicit documentation that a TOTP code appears immediately after the scan.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account

citations.quote: Open Ente Auth. Tap the add button and scan the QR code shown by the service.

Added support for importing 2FA codes from QR code images on desktop.
